provenance.interpretation: Methods are preserved as candidate operating procedures. Sultan case claims were source-checked on 2026-09-02; cross-case claims retain their individual verification limits.

style_system_model.definition: A style candidate is a visual production system, not a list of aesthetic tags or a single hero image.
required_questions: What should the player feel over long-term play?
Through what material or medium does this world record itself?
Which production limits must become inputs to the style?
Which gameplay information must remain readable?
Can the project be recognized without a logo?
Can ordinary assets be produced repeatedly at measured cost?

workflow.name: constraint_inventory
workflow.exit_condition: The hardest asset family to sustain is explicitly identified.

workflow.name: authorial_single_artifact_loop
procedure: Give the visual author a bounded problem without prescribing the visual solution.
Produce one complete real-content artifact at true intended use and scale.
Let the user judge whether the work has life as a whole.
Record visual inventions worth absorbing backwards into world, narrative or mechanics.
Distill the next requirement from the observed success or failure.
Repeat one artifact at a time until a direction survives ordinary content.
workflow.exit_condition: At least one real artifact is accepted as alive and a second ordinary artifact demonstrates that the relationship can continue.

workflow.name: same_content_candidate_tests
workflow.demotion_reason: Faust's own four-image menu experiment failed to produce a living direction. The examined case summaries also do not show pre-frozen batteries or scored menus as the decisive mechanism, but that absence is only supporting context and not a universal industry rule.
workflow.usage_rule: Run only after 2-3 directions already attract the user. Test content must be distilled from real project content and images the user responded to, not frozen in advance.
workflow.rule: Every candidate must solve the same content with the same constraints.

workflow.name: rule_replication
workflow.procedure: Compress the candidate into one page and ask a person who did not participate in exploration to create one small asset.
workflow.failure_interpretation: First question whether the rules are externalizable; do not default to blaming the contributor.

workflow.name: decision
workflow.rule: Decide only after measured evidence is attached to raw scores and disagreements are preserved.

principles: Study function from games rather than copying surfaces.
Use historical media, material aging, architecture and nature to generate visual vocabulary.
Do not let a moodboard substitute for rules.
Do not import external screenshots or protected assets into the project without an explicit licensed-asset decision.

oral_source_governance.principle: Verifying that a developer said something does not make the statement a measured production fact or a hard project constraint.
oral_source_governance.hard_constraint_gate: A hard Faust constraint requires verifiable project data, an observable product boundary, a formal production decision, or explicit user adoption after considering transfer fit. Interview speech alone is insufficient.
oral_source_governance.causal_inference_guard: A final visual detail being compatible with a prior theme, mechanic or constraint does not prove it was derived from that input. Preserve the origin as unknown unless the creator describes the link or a contemporaneous artifact records it.

style_grammar_method.texture_budget_method: Allow one primary high-frequency texture region on screen and reduce noise elsewhere.

exception_method.rule: Exceptions must be rare, narratively meaningful and explicitly logged.

style_roi_discussion_model.warning: Discussion aid only; not a financial metric.

scoring_method.demotion_reason: Faust's four-image menu failed to produce a living project direction, and the examined case summaries do not show weighted scoring as the decisive mechanism. This is a Faust workflow decision, not a universal industry law; the evidence also does not support a universal single-authority decision model. See FAUST-ART-RESEARCH-002.
rules: Store raw scores and measured evidence before weighted totals.
Preserve disagreement instead of reporting only averages.
Do not create a separate beauty score; record functional reasons.
Do not score before the same-content assets exist.

principles: Test irreversible or high-volume decisions first.
Do not retain a direction because of sunk cost.
Do not use one hero image as the representative sample.
Prefer real game captures over moodboards in decisions.

amendments.trigger: Faust's four-image menu failed, while the ten case summaries in FAUST-ART-RESEARCH-002 did not provide an observed example of pre-frozen test batteries or scored menus being decisive. This is evidence for revising Faust's workflow, not proof that successful teams never use such tools.
changes: workflow phase 1 (same_content_candidate_tests) demoted from mandatory phase to optional stress-test toolkit.
scoring_method demoted from decision procedure to discussion aid; scorecard remains not_run and must not gate decisions.

default exploration path replaced: single user-attracted direction -> one real content artifact at true spec -> confront in real use -> failures distill requirement list -> iterate. Final decision = user judgment on real content.
amendments.revisit_trigger: If the user later requests a formal comparison of 2+ surviving directions, the demoted toolkit may be reactivated for that purpose only.

amendments.trigger: User confirmed that Sultan-style differential validation must test whether the discovery process can independently produce a comparably strong solution, not whether the result resembles Sultan's Game.
changes: Added authorial_single_artifact_loop as the default phase before optional comparison and stress testing.
Defined artistic freedom as bounded authorship over the solution, not an absent brief or random generation.
Made reverse absorption of useful visual accidents into world and design an explicit required step.
Made style grammar retrospective: it must compress accepted repeated work rather than prescribe the first artifact.
Defined four differential gates: process parity, functional parity, quality parity and transfer parity.
Recorded that prior exposure to Sultan's final style contaminates strict blind rediscovery; a future blind calibration must hide surface outcomes.
amendments.revisit_trigger: Revise after primary interview pages are captured and any exact chronology, staffing or iteration claims are verified or rejected.

data_integrity_rules: Empty or not-run measurements remain empty or explicitly not_run.
Hypotheses must not be converted to confirmed project decisions without a user decision or recorded experiment.
External case-study claims must be verified before registration as external facts.
Every score must retain reviewer role and evidence.
Every killed direction should retain transferable lessons.
Changes to approved grammar require a decision log and revisit trigger.
Do not reverse-engineer a deterministic cause for a visual invention merely because the final form fits earlier narrative or production information.
